name: Taro
source: A young boy that awakened in the basement of a mansion without any memories. He was given the name Taro and was made into one of the servants of the house. There, he is treated as dog and and they refer to him as cattle. Everyday he has to bear the humiliations and sexual harassment inflicted by the ladies and maids of the mansion, but he is happy with that life.
